Messages.Author: Ted Cabeen
Messages.Body:
Mark A Randle (ee9...@brunel.ac.uk) wrote:
: Dose the stealth modifier on directed actions apply to cards

: that can be afected by directed actions, ie do you get +3 stealth from
: Night Moves when trying to steal the rack. Also for Cryptic Mission do
: you get the stealth as it is in bold at the top of the card.

You cannot use a bleed card for the stealth (ie. bonding and Night
moves), but cryptic mission is a +1 stealth.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ee9...@brunel.ac.uk (Mark A Randle) writes:

> Dose the stealth modifier on directed actions apply to cards
>that can be afected by directed actions, ie do you get +3 stealth from
>Night Moves when trying to steal the rack. Also for Cryptic Mission do
>you get the stealth as it is in bold at the top of the card.

Cards that are affected by directed actions DO NOT require an action
card.

Your example: Stealing the rack. ANY minion may attempt to steal the
rack as a (D) action. Just tap the minion and announce that he's going
to steal the rack for you. NO CARD NEEDED.
(Tom's answered this base question many times.)

So, no, you can't use +3 stealth from Night Moves to steal the rack,
Because the minion playing night moves is not stealing the rack -
he's bleeding somebody (card text).

But, yes, a vampire attempting a Cryptic Mission (superior or not)
get +1 stealth - but only for the cryptic mission. You can't use
that card to steal the rack, burn the rat army, or anything else.
